note: Brotli bytes. Lower these by hand when a change shrinks a build; --check fails 2% over, when a fixture bundles a package its budget forbids, or when baseline-only code (0064) reaches a chunk a WebGPU session loads. `fallback` counts the chunks only the baseline tier loads. renderer-min fallback: the WebGL2 shim (gpu-webgl2, ~22 KB) and the baseline strategies; naga (342 KB wasm) loads only on a translation-cache miss. 0074 raised renderer-min: the always-on profiler (spans, aggregates, render/<node> and GPU/worker tracks) by 2.6 KB, WebGL2's timer queries by 0.8 KB of fallback; captures, sampling and traces load with import().
